title: 🎨 Palette: Add ARIA roles to alert notifications
body:
💡 **What:** Added `role="alert"` to dynamically rendered error and success messages (`alert-box` components) in the main layout. Added `aria-label="Dismiss alert"` to the associated dismiss buttons.
🎯 **Why:** Screen readers do not automatically announce conditionally rendered messages unless they have an appropriate ARIA role (like `alert`). Furthermore, icon-only or generic buttons (like "Dismiss") benefit from explicit ARIA labels for better context.
📸 **Before/After:** Visually identical, but significantly improved experience for assistive technologies.
♿ **Accessibility:** Screen readers will now announce the content of error/success messages immediately when they appear on the screen. The dismiss button is now clearly labeled.
